info.name: Limble API V2 Assets Priorities API

items.docs:
This request returns your priorities in Limble. 

Return data description

Property: priorityID, Description: The priority's unique identifier.
Property: name, Description: The full name of the priority.
Property: priorityLevel, Description: A number representing ordering or indicator of severity.
Property: color, Description: A hex-color string that will be used to color tasks associated to this priority.

This request creates a new Priority.

This request updates a Priority.

**When providing priorityLevel or isDefault, calls to this endpoint may reorder or otherwise adjust** _**other**_ **priorities.**

This call simply removes a priority from Limble.

Things to keep in mind when using this endpoint:

- 
Calls to this endpoint will potentially adjust other priorities' priorityLevels.

- If you delete a priority that isDefault, you will not have a default priority anymore, and that may cause issues.

- If you delete a priority that has tasks associated to it, those tasks will have their priority removed.
